⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
References a single position inside an [`archetypes.AssetAudio`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/archetypes/asset_audio?speculative-link).

Used to bind the media time of a complete audio asset to a Rerun timeline.
Log one [`archetypes.AudioSampleReference`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/archetypes/audio_sample_reference?speculative-link) at each timeline position where
the asset should be "at" the given media timestamp; between references
the viewer interpolates linearly in media-time.

To play an entire asset aligned to a timeline, log a reference at the
start of the asset and another at the end — or, equivalently, log a
reference per visible frame for sub-frame alignment.

## Fields
### Required
* `timestamp`: [`AudioTimestamp`](../components/audio_timestamp.md)

### Optional
* `audio_reference`: [`EntityPath`](../components/entity_path.md)
